verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Supermemory accepts raw files and documents. Its ingestion pipeline detects the content type (PDF, images, video, code) and applies type-specific extraction such as OCR for images and transcription for audio and video. Hybrid search then recalls both memories and document chunks from that content. Missing for 10: a documented file-upload API or code example in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration that file ingestion and recall work as claimed.
